title: Guided filing journey — ANDS Studio
walkthrough:
You land on a page with a top bar branded "ANDS Studio" and the subtext "· guided ANDS filing", with chips for "Help", "My dossiers", "Portfolio", "Registry", and "Correspondence". The hero headline reads "File your ANDS with Health Canada — guided end to end." A paragraph below states that an Abbreviated New Drug Submission is one of the most complex filings a company can make, and that this walks you through it step by step — every term explained in plain language with the regulatory vocabulary kept precise, the right pathway chosen for your product, and your submission's readiness visible at every moment until it's ready to send. You click "Start my submission →" (it shows "Starting…" while working); below it a second link reads "Or open your dossiers — every product in submission →". A footnote says "Grounded in real Health Canada process · your progress is saved automatically".

The screen splits into three: a left rail titled "Your filing journey" listing 10 steps (done steps show a checkmark and "Done", the current one "You're here", later ones a padlock with a plain-language lock reason); a center step card showing e.g. "Step 1 of 10"; and a right panel with a 3D "tower" of stacked module tiles plus a "Readiness" card reading "● BLOCKED" or "● READY TO FILE", a progress bar, and "The single thing standing between you and ready:" with a resume button.

Step 1 is a "Tell me about your drug" form: "What's your drug?", "What are you filing?" (options like "Generic of an approved brand (ANDS)"), "Dosage form", and a checkbox "It's for a new use the brand isn't approved for". Clicking "Check my pathway" returns a routing verdict and warnings.

Next steps ask for a "Your Health Canada Company ID" (you must already know your 5-digit ID or enrol by sending a completed Company Template to hc.osip-bpip.sc@canada.ca and wait a couple of weeks; a control lets you continue: "I've requested it — continue while it's pending →") and a "Dossier ID" — you must know its format, one letter plus 6–7 digits like e123456; blurring the field validates it ("✓ Valid Dossier ID format."). The submission step pre-fills "Drug product" and asks for "Applicant (your company name)".

The content step links "Open the Module builder →" to place documents into eCTD Modules 1–5 on a separate dossiers page; the Continue button stays disabled with "Place the required documents to continue" until the gate clears ("✓ All required documents are in — you can continue."). Later steps run validation ("✓ Validation passed…" or "✗ N error(s) to fix"), a fees checkbox "My small-business status is already granted", internal QA review, e-signature, and transmission — explained as riding the US FDA gateway, with three receipt tiles "FDA MDN", "FDA ACK", "HC ACK (Core ID)" and the note "You get three receipts, in order". The final step explains Health Canada's review timelines. Each card ends with one primary button plus a "Next:" hint; the top bar shows a live "% ready" or "Ready to file" chip and "Start over".
